title: Permutation of sign vectors
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\pi$ be a permutation of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Permuting the coordinates of a sign vector by $\pi$ defines a bijection from $\{-1,1\}^n$ to itself, with inverse given by permuting coordinates by $\pi^{-1}$.
